name: ApexLogics Careertech Suite
description: 146 deterministic, client-side, zero-egress edtech/careertech decision tools at apexlogics.org — career ROI, compensation, education finance, credentials, immigration, equity/freelance tax, workforce analytics, and pedagogy. Each emits an OpenChainGraph-conformant artifact carrying a verifiable SHA-256 execution_hash, and captures an inbound parent artifact via the ?ap2= handoff for runtime chaining (OpenChainGraph Standard v0.5.0).

provider.organization: Post Oak Labs / Post Oak Labs

extensions.description: Emits OpenChainGraph verifiable decision artifacts (hash-anchored, chainable). See the OpenChainGraph Standard v0.5.0.

params.l2_mechanism: ?ap2= URL handoff — a downstream tool opened with ?ap2=<parent artifact JSON> copies the parent execution_hash/tool_id into its chain block (chain_depth = parent + 1). The chain block is outside the hash preimage, so a tool's own execution_hash is unchanged with or without a parent.
params.conformance_note: L1 envelopes + L2 runtime parent capture are in every migrated tool; verify a workflow round-trip (export tool A -> open tool B via ?ap2= -> B.chain.parent_hashes set, B's own hash unchanged) to confirm L4 end-to-end.

skills.name: Compensation & Offers
skills.description: Model total compensation, offer negotiation, equity/RSU/ISO/ESPP outcomes, geo-fiscal arbitrage, and benefits across job offers and scenarios.
examples: Compare two job offers on total after-tax compensation
Model RSU withholding gap and ISO/AMT exposure

skills.name: Education & Credential ROI
skills.description: NPV/IRR of degrees, MBAs, professional and graduate programs, certifications, and licensing — against earnings uplift and opportunity cost.
examples: Run NPV/IRR on an MBA vs. staying in role

skills.name: Career Transition & Mobility
skills.description: Automation-displacement risk, transferable-skill gaps, job-search ROI, career-break cost, severance, and raise-vs-leave decisions.
examples: Score occupation AI-displacement risk and upskilling ROI
Model the EV of asking for a raise vs. job-hopping

skills.name: Student Finance & Loans
skills.description: FAFSA/SAI, 529 projection, scholarship ROI, OBBBA RAP vs. standard repayment, PSLF tracking, refinancing break-even, ISA vs. loan.
examples: Compare OBBBA RAP vs. standard repayment

skills.name: Equity & Freelance Tax
skills.description: QBI/199A, S-corp election, solo 401(k) vs. SEP-IRA, 83(b), QSBS/1202, quarterly estimates, and equity-exit waterfalls.

skills.name: Immigration & Visa

examples: Map an F-1 → OPT → H-1B visa pathway
Estimate the cost of a green-card wait

skills.name: Workforce & HR Analytics

examples: Quantify turnover cost and retention-investment ROI
